note: Open the game at /?replay on a fresh page load, wait for `await window.__ready` (character models loaded), then run window.__replay.run(1234, 7200) in the console. hash, calls and count must match. v3: game randomness now goes through rand() in util.ts, so the seeded stream no longer includes three.js UUID draws and is independent of how the scene is built (verified: same hash with world merging on and off). Earlier baselines: v1 (SEG_N=10, pre-refactor) hash 1101932839 calls 130842; v2 (SEG_N=6) hash 1202051037 calls 125821. Both were reproduced by the refactor before rand() was introduced. Phase 2 (skinned characters) left the hash unchanged: character construction draws exactly the same rand() values as the old procedural people (3 per crowd member, 4 per influencer).
